latest.author: BaZZtian
latest.text: Hi @nokou! For PhazonPrime (Prime 1, PPSA99731), rename your own supported raw ISO to owned-pal.iso and place it next to eboot.bin: /data/homebrew/PPSA99731/owned-pal.iso The supported disc is the PAL/Europe GameCube version, disc ID GM8P01, revision 0. Close the app before copying the ISO, then launch it again. Preserve your userdata/ folder when updating. Installation instructions
